name: Prometeon
verdict: Prometeon Tyre Group, the truck/agro tyre business spun out of Pirelli in 2017, is controlled through China National Tire & Rubber Co.
note: Rating note: Sinochem's own newsroom carries the same 38% CNRC/Prometeon transaction, confirming the state chain. ON HOLD: the only claim is about Pirelli's shareholder, not about Prometeon's own ownership.
